From 1988 to 1989, the story follows Jotaro Kujo and his friends as they journey from Tokyo to Cairo, Egypt, to save the life of his mother, Holy Kujo, by defeating his family's resurrected archenemy, DIO.

Key threads from this canonical page lead to Jotaro Kujo, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (manga), Egypt (DIO's mansion), Battle Tendency, Golden Wind and Joseph Joestar. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

page.overview:
What is Stardust Crusaders?

From 1988 to 1989, the story follows Jotaro Kujo and his friends as they journey from Tokyo to Cairo, Egypt, to save the life of his mother, Holy Kujo, by defeating his family's resurrected archenemy, DIO.

Jotaro travels with his grandfather, Joseph Joestar, as well as Muhammad Avdol, Noriaki Kakyoin, Jean Pierre Polnareff, and Iggy. The group fights several of DIO's minions and Stand users along the way.

Volumes are published in English by VIZ Media, and in Italian by .

Stardust Crusaders was the first part to be officially released in English. The series is edited by Jason Thompson, author of .

Also known as: Part 3, JoJo Part 3, SC.
